---
title: "Choose Your Own Project: Handwritten Character Recognition"
subtitle: "edX HarvardX: PH125.9x - Data Science: Capstone"
site: bookdown::bookdown_site
author: "Azamat Kurbanaev"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
bibliography: ref.bib
csl: bit-numerical-mathematics.csl 
envir:
  .GlobalEnv
output: 
  bookdown::pdf_document2: 
    df_print: paged
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 4
    fig_caption: true
    keep_tex: true
    css: custom.css
    citation_package: biblatex
    delete_merged_file: true
documentclass: report
biblatexoptions:
  - backend=biber
  - natbib=true 
  - style=numeric
  - backref=true
  - sorting=none
colorlinks: true
linkcolor: red
citecolor: blue
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{awesomebox}
  - \usepackage{hyperref}
  - \usepackage{amsmath}
  - \hypersetup{backref,
        pdfpagemode=Normal,
        colorlinks=true,
        implicit=false}
  - \usepackage{tcolorbox}
  - \usepackage{xcolor}
  - \tcbuselibrary{skins}
  - |
    % 1. Environment with a thick colored left accent bar
    \newtcolorbox{accentquote}{
      enhanced,
      colback=gray!5!white,     % Light background
      colframe=gray!20!white,   % Subtle outer border (or make transparent)
      borderline west={4pt}{0pt}{blue!60!black}, % Thick left accent bar
      boxrule=0pt,
      left=12pt,
      right=12pt,
      top=8pt,
      bottom=8pt,
      before skip=10pt,
      after skip=10pt
    }

    % 2. Environment with a left icon/title banner
    \newtcolorbox{iconquote}{
      enhanced,
      colback=blue!3!white,
      colframe=blue!30!black,
      boxrule=0.5pt,
      left=10pt,
      right=10pt,
      top=8pt,
      bottom=8pt,
      before skip=10pt,
      after skip=10pt,
      fonttitle=\bfseries,
      title=💡 Note
    }
  
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{RMarkdown Citations - Numeric Style}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::knitr}
